description: Buy a fixed dollar amount of one token or tokenized stock on a schedule.

TOKEN.description: the token as the owner named it: a ticker (VIRTUAL, ETH, TSLA) or the address they gave. The title shows it. A crypto ticker also needs ADDRESS and CHAIN_ID, and ETH needs CHAIN_ID. If the owner named no chain and gave no address, ask them to pick on a card listing each token-search match by name, chain and address, plus a tile to paste their own — even with one match, because token-search leaves unverified tokens out. A tokenized stock is its ticker alone

ADDRESS.description: the contract address of a crypto TOKEN named by ticker, on CHAIN_ID (a Solana mint verbatim). Not set for an address TOKEN, for ETH, BNB or SOL, or for a tokenized stock

CHAIN_ID.description: the chain of a crypto token or coin, as a numeric id: Base 8453, Ethereum 1, BSC 56, Arbitrum 42161, Robinhood 4663, Solana 1151111081099710. A tokenized stock takes none — the rail buys it on the venue that returns the most shares

SIZING.description: dollar-cost averaging is fixed-size by definition

SIZE_USD.description: dollars per buy. A tokenized stock also has its own buy floor, per ticker: read it with bevo-read stock-min <TICKER> and tell the owner its minUsd before filing when SIZE_USD is under it — a fire under the floor buys nothing
